families.lightActualView: Raster generated from an image prompt text. Shows 50 cancer plus 50 normal cells, V marking the variant copy; 50/200=25% and 50/150 about 33%; purity 50% and CCF 100%. Arithmetic matches the page. The prompt file is public-custody metadata only. Upper panel title says "Two copies per cancer cell" while a V bar plus an unmarked bar is shown: consistent.

darkActualView.finding: NOT a recolour of the light PNG: both are 1024x1536 but the dark one is a separately generated raster. Preserved: titles, 50 cancer and 50 normal cells, V on one local copy, 2 versus 1 local copy, 100+100=200 and 50+100=150, 50/200=25% and 50/150 about 33%, purity 50%, CCF 100%. Differences from light: the variant copy V is purple in the dark version (orange in the light version), so V cannot be identified by colour across themes and relies on its letter; the dark legend adds five coloured dots (purple, green, orange, blue, yellow) whose colours do not map consistently to the drawing (for example the orange dot sits beside CCF while orange also marks the VAF result box); in the dark upper panel the cell glyph is less cartoon-like. No scientific content differs, but the two themes are two independent images and the dark legend dots are misleading decoration.
darkActualView.rendererOrCoverageLimitation: legend dot colours not meaningful; variant copy colour differs between themes
darkActualView.viewMethod: Read tool on raw PNG as shipped (no derivative)
